name: fmnist_emlp1
task: Task 51: Fashion-MNIST, ReBoot eMLP-1, plaintext twin against Table 4 (ReBoot column)

dataset.name: Fashion-MNIST (Xiao, Rasul, Vollgraf 2017; Zalando SE, MIT License)
dataset.preprocessing_note: Table 2: 14 x 14 inputs. ReBoot's MNIST pipeline as recorded by gpu-runner (R-REB-3): resize to 14, then min-max scaling over the 60k training set. hekit's data::reboot_preprocess (antialiased bicubic, a = -0.5) reproduces ReBoot's 14 x 14 MNIST arrays to < 1e-6 (test resize_matches_reboot_14x14_mnist); the same pipeline is applied to Fashion-MNIST (an assumption: the paper does not state per-dataset preprocessing).

model.name: eMLP-1 = RE-Block(32) (paper Table 3)
model.output_width_note: 10 classes padded to 16 outputs with zero targets, as ReBoot does on MNIST (configs/reboot_emlp1_faithful.json); accuracy is the argmax over the 10 real classes.

train.hyperparameters_source: paper Table 8, Fashion-MNIST, ReBoot row, eMLP-1: lr 0.0005, weight decay 0.0, batch 48
train.epochs_note: Not stated in the paper. Chosen before any run: 50 epochs, the same as the MNIST paper-setting reproduction R-REB-3; accuracy is reported at epochs 10, 20, 50 and at each seed's best epoch (test-set selected, optimistic), as R-REB-3 did.

target.source: ReBoot paper (arXiv:2506.19693) Table 4, Fashion-MNIST eMLP-1, ReBoot column (plaintext, 10 runs): 85.12 ± 0.20
